d: The Mavericks defeated the Thunder, 120-96 tonight in Dallas. Cooper Flagg contributed a team-high 26 points to go with 8 assists 5 rebounds and 2 three pointers, with P.J. Washington of the Mavericks adding an additional 18 points (7-16 FG, 2-7 3P) in the game. Ajay Mitchell finished with a team-high 29 points along with 4 rebounds for the Thunder in the losing effort. The Mavericks improve their record to 3-2 with the win, while the Thunder fall to 4-1 for the season.
